notes.text: Chris Tanev is out (lower-body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their most valuable skaters.

Nick Blankenburg is on injured reserve (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 15 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Troy Stecher has taken his spot beside Oliver Ekman-Larsson. That pair has had 51% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 76:24 together, about what it had with Blankenburg (48%).
Jack Roslovic is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward. Nick Paul has taken his spot beside Auston Matthews and Easton Cowan.
Kirill Marchenko returned in their last game after missing 12 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Aatu Räty was added to the roster on Nov 23 and has played beside William Nylander and Dakota Joshua.
Oliver Ekman-Larsson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 31% of the team’s shorthanded time in 26 games, up from 6% last season.

stakes: The Maple Leafs go in tied for seventh in the Atlantic with 23 points, 10 points behind the Panthers, second.

story.head: Tavares’s favorite opponent
paras: The Maple Leafs have won two in a row, and the Panthers have won three straight. This is an Atlantic Division matchup, with the Panthers second (tied for seventh in the NHL) and the Maple Leafs last (tied for 25th).

The Panthers’ record (.635) is about what their chances are worth. The Maple Leafs have played better than their record (.426) says: their chances are worth about .493, mostly because they’re 3-10 in one-goal games.

This season, the Panthers have outscored teams 84-76, even though they’ve been outscored 50-44 at 5-on-5. On special teams, they’ve outscored teams 26-18, and only one team creates more chances on the power play.

The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st) and rarely ice the puck (1st), but don’t block many shots (32nd). On the other side, the Maple Leafs get their shots through better than anyone (1st), but take a lot of low-quality shots (31st) and take more penalties than they draw (30th). The Panthers’ power play (3rd) could do real damage against the Maple Leafs’ penalty kill (26th). On top of that, the Cats keep shots away, but the Maple Leafs give up plenty.

Matthew Tkachuk (7 G / 28 A / 35 P in 26 GP) leads the Panthers in scoring and is sixth in the NHL. Sam Reinhart (12 G / 11 A / 23 P in 26 GP) has a team-high twelve goals, with seven goals in eleven games against Toronto since 2023-24. Auston Matthews (14 G / 20 A / 34 P in 27 GP) leads the Maple Leafs in scoring and is tied for seventh in the NHL, and William Nylander (11 G / 14 A / 25 P in 27 GP) isn’t far behind.
Jacob Markström (9-4-1 / .895 SV% in 15 GS) will likely start for Florida, and Anthony Stolarz (7-5-1 / .907 SV% in 13 GS) for Toronto.
At home, Jim Hiller likes to send McKenna, Sissons and Tavares out against opponents’ third lines, so watch for them against Luostarinen, Lundell and Marchand.

items.text: John Tavares has a point in seven straight games against Florida.

The Maple Leafs are newly without Chris Tanev and Jack Roslovic, and have been without Nick Blankenburg since Oct 22. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, only the Mammoth and the Avalanche are missing more right now.
Sam Bennett has twelve goals on chances worth about 7.2 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
Nick Paul has one goal on chances worth about 4.8 goals, well below what his finishing usually turns chances into. If the chances keep coming, so should the goals.
